_comment: Tests node 1 routing for Village Remedies (Aussie ack tone): booking routes to book_intent, cancellation routes to cancel_intent, info routes silently to info_pivot.

scenarios.name: Booking intent routes to book_intent with Aussie ack

history.content: I want to book an acupuncture appointment

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack ('No worries!' / 'Sounds good!') then calls universal_router intent='book_intent' with implied_service='acupuncture' (or similar). FAIL if agent asks for more service detail, routes to info_pivot, or omits the tool call.

scenarios.name: Cancellation intent routes to cancel_intent with Aussie ack

history.content: I need to cancel my appointment

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack then calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent'. FAIL if agent routes to book_intent or info_pivot.

scenarios.name: Info question routes to info_pivot with a filler phrase

history.content: What does a physiotherapy session involve?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='info_pivot', in the same turn. FAIL if agent answers the question inline, omits the filler phrase, or speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase.

scenarios.name: Rambling hesitant caller with embedded insurance question (real-call regression)

history.content: Hi, um, my name is Ben. Um, I wanna-- I was referred by one of your patients, uh, Henry. Uh, yeah, I just wanna give it a try. I'm just wondering how, how you charge. Um, I've got a Bupa. I'm with a Bupa insurance. Um...

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set, then calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' in the same turn (per the current shared system_prompt.txt INFO PIVOT rule). FAIL if agent produces zero spoken output, speaks anything other than a TOOL-CALL FILLER phrase, asks a clarifying question instead of routing, or fails to call any tool.

scenarios.name: contact-clinic-affirmative-asks-for-content

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_first_name}}='Ben'
Can I speak to someone?
I'm not able to transfer your call to reception, but I can pass on a message for them to call you back.
Yeah.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: CONTENT SCAN finds no message_body ('Yeah.' carries no reason beyond the affirmative), so MESSAGE STEP fires — agent asks 'What would you like me to pass on?' with ZERO tool calls this turn. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router intent='leave_message' this turn with an invented/default message_body without first asking what the caller wants passed on.

scenarios.name: duration-concern-not-reschedule

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_first_name}}='Ben'
Leave a message for the acupuncturist.
What would you like me to pass on?
I want to make sure I'm booked in for the right amount of time — I think I only need thirty minutes rather than an hour.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: the EXCLUSION (appointment length/type concern, no day or time named) applies — no different day or time was named, only a duration/type concern — so INTENT-IN-MESSAGE INTERCEPT does NOT fire and the agent does NOT offer to reschedule. Falls through to ordinary LEAVE MESSAGE handling with the caller's own words as message_body. FAIL if: agent offers to reschedule or asks 'Would you like me to do that instead?'.

scenarios.name: Waitlist request routes to book_intent as booking inquiry

history.content: Can you put me on the waitlist in case someone cancels?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack ('No worries!' / 'Sounds good!') then calls universal_router intent='book_intent' in the same turn (SIGNAL 1 — BOOKING INTENT, Waitlist trigger). FAIL if agent asks clarifying questions first, routes to info_pivot, or produces zero tool call.

scenarios.name: Cancellation list phrasing (not 'waitlist' verbatim) still routes to book_intent

history.content: I want to stay on the cancellation list for a sooner spot

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one Aussie ack then calls universal_router intent='book_intent' (SIGNAL 1 — BOOKING INTENT, Waitlist trigger matches 'cancellation list' phrasing). FAIL if agent treats this as an info question or fails to fire Signal 1.

scenarios.name: name-save-no-intent-yes — caller confirms name update with no other request → single greeting, zero tool call

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_first_name}}='Tyson'
No, it's Sylvia.
Hi Sylvia! I have this number saved under Tyson — would you like me to update it to Sylvia for next time?
Sure.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller confirmed the name update (STEP 2 YES) and has not stated any service/booking/cancel/info request yet — the 'No original intent' sub-branch applies. PASS if: agent speaks exactly one turn of 'Hi Sylvia! How can I help you today?' (or equivalent single greeting) and makes ZERO tool calls this turn — save_caller_name/patient_name_raw flags are carried as ACTIVE CONTEXT into the next universal_router call, not sent now. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router this turn — that produces a DV update mid-turn and risks the greeting being spoken twice in the same call (same bug class as conv_1401m1djt060fmzbz5gv7887ggf3, 2026-09-01). FAIL if: agent speaks the greeting more than once.

scenarios.name: name-save-no-intent-no — caller declines name update with no other request → single ack, zero tool call

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_first_name}}='Tyson'
No, it's Priya.
Hi Priya! I have this number saved under Tyson — would you like me to update it to Priya for next time?
No, leave it.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller declined the name update (STEP 2 NO) and has not stated any service/booking/cancel/info request yet. PASS if: agent speaks exactly one turn of 'No problem! How can I help you today?' (or equivalent) and makes ZERO tool calls this turn — phone_owner_denied/patient_name_raw flags are carried as ACTIVE CONTEXT into the next universal_router call, not sent now. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router this turn. FAIL if: agent speaks more than once.

scenarios.name: name-save-with-book-intent-yes — caller states name AND booking intent together → ack + tool call still fires (regression check)

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{caller_first_name}}='Tyson'
No, it's Sylvia — I'd like to book an appointment.
Hi Sylvia! I have this number saved under Tyson — would you like me to update it to Sylvia for next time?
Yes please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller confirmed the name update AND already stated a booking intent in the Step 1 turn — the book_intent sub-branch applies, not 'No original intent'. PASS if: agent speaks 'Hi Sylvia!' (or equivalent single line) AND calls universal_router intent='book_intent' with save_caller_name='true' in the payload, in the same turn. FAIL if: agent makes zero tool calls (that would strand the booking request). FAIL if: agent speaks the generic 'How can I help you today?' greeting instead of proceeding with the booking.
